title: mespilus monogyna var. azarella
intro: Mespilus monogyna var. azarella, commonly known as a variety of the whitebeam tree, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to support digestive health and to alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Mespilus monogyna var. azarella are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
